name: Live Baby Brine Shrimp
description: Freshly hatched Artemia nauplii — the classic live fry + small-fish food, hatched from cysts at home, so no brand and no standardized protein label (proteinPct omitted rather than fabricated). wasteFactor (0.12) is MODELLED — tiny live prey are chased and eaten almost completely, the lowest-waste food in the set.
notes: Live nauplii die in fresh water within hours; uneaten ones decay, so the low waste assumes they're eaten promptly. Hatched from cysts — no manufacturer protein spec exists for the live product.
